siteDescription: These are the three things that get me through every deadline — energy, a quiet space, and the laptop that does all the work.

models.shortDescription: A 250ml Red Bull — the difference between finishing a chapter at 2am or giving up. Open it, crush it, hear it.
models.longDescription: A realistic 3D model of a Red Bull 250ml energy drink can. Use the buttons below to interact with the model.
models.technicalNote: This Red Bull can was modelled in Blender 5.1 with accurate 250ml slim can dimensions (26.5mm radius, 134.5mm height). The label texture was UV-mapped cylindrically. The pull tab, rivet, and drinking hole score line were modelled as separate objects for realism.

models.shortDescription: The room where it all happens. Desk, bed, window, lamp. Toggle the lamp on for those late-night sessions.
models.longDescription: An interactive room environment featuring a desk with computer, bed, table lamp, window, and floor rug. Toggle the lamp and explore the space.
models.technicalNote: This room was modelled in Blender with multiple interactive elements. The L-shaped layout demonstrates complex architectural geometry beyond simple product modelling.

models.shortDescription: The MacBook itself. Open the lid, watch it boot, and see the screen come to life — same as every assignment morning.
models.longDescription: Open the lid and watch the screen come to life. A demonstration of multi-stage 3D animation, dynamic lighting and material state changes.
models.technicalNote: This MacBook was modelled in Blender with an armature-driven hinge animation. The lid, screen, keyboard backlight and Apple-style logo are individually controlled materials that respond to power state changes via JavaScript.
